cases.id: daily: a timed exercise, then a REPS one shown, hidden and shown again
a running timer counts in the background
an untimed step doesn't count in the background
an explicit pause is not counted
nothing counts before the first action; opening and leaving records nothing
counting before start is kept by the first save
process death mid-workout, reopened within 2 h: the old session is recorded with the last saved time
process death, then the app starts exactly 2 h later: still open
process death, then the app starts 2 h + 1 ms later: recorded
back after more than 2 h on the same screen: the old session is recorded and the count restarts
back after exactly 2 h: the same session goes on
the clock moved back: never inactive
the clock moved forward over 2 h: closed lazily
a second start and a second finish do nothing
another workout of the same kind is open: starting records it first
a long workout: many checkpoints
three sets: first → last
a set exactly 2 h after the last one extends the session
a set 2 h + 1 ms after the last one records the old session and starts a new one
closeInactive after 2 h + 1 s records it; at 2 h it stays
the clock moved back: the start moves to now, never a negative duration
two workouts' sessions are independent
a single set: duration 0
sets then the routine completed: one entry dated now, first → last set
a completion shown again (a reload) records nothing more
1 h 59 min without a set: still open
exactly 2 h without a set: still open
2 h 1 min without a set: recorded (dated on its start, at its last set) and the progress reset
a late set after 2 h + 1 ms records the old session first, then starts a new one
a manual reset discards the session without recording it
the clock moved back: never closed, never negative
two routines are independent
